new: 批注卡片现已自适应窄栏、宽屏以及段落下方等多种视图布局。
improvements: 界面按钮恢复了强调色边框样式，并新增了柔和、圆点和紧凑等多种外观选项。
商店中的卡片操作按钮统一采用了边框样式与规范的固定尺寸。
other: 在主题设计规范中新增了段落下方批注卡片的最大宽度配置。

new: Annotation cards now adapt flexibly across narrow, wide, and below-paragraph views.
improvements: Interface buttons now feature restored accent outlines alongside new soft, dot, and compact appearance options.
Card action buttons in the store now use a unified outline style with standardized fixed dimensions.
other: Added a theme design token to define the maximum width for annotation cards placed below content.

new: 插件管理器现在支持按顺序批量应用更新。
插件商店的搜索框旁新增「全部更新」按钮。
The plugin supervisor now supports applying batch updates sequentially.
The plugin store now has an Update All button beside the search box.

fixes: 插件商店中的插件详情页在闲置时不再自动关闭。
Plugin detail pages in the store now remain open instead of automatically closing when idle.

improvements: 应用详情页现在将「打开设置」设为主要操作，并提供共享的更新检查。
有新版本可用时，应用卡片现在显示「更新」而非「打开」。
Hero 开关现在会描出轨道轮廓，让标题栏中的切换按钮保持清晰可见。
已停用插件的提示现在显示在休眠概览卡片中。
App details now make Open Settings the primary action and share the update check.
App cards now show Update instead of Open when a newer version is available.
Hero switches now outline their tracks so title bar toggles remain visible.
Disabled plugin notices now appear within the dormant overview card.

new: 插件系统现已支持从商店获取并读取版本更新日志。
应用商店的插件详情页新增了更新日志标签页，便于查阅各版本的历史更新记录。
The plugin system now supports fetching and reading version changelogs from the store.
Plugin detail pages in the App Store now feature a dedicated Changelog tab to display version update histories.
批注边栏卡片中的 AI 回答现在会以只读 Markdown 格式呈现。
AI answers in margin cards now render as read-only Markdown.
批注页边卡片现已支持直接针对 AI 回复进行追问。
Margin annotation cards now allow you to follow up directly on AI replies.

improvements: 插件标题栏的操作按钮统一采用轻量的幽灵样式，并隐藏了多余的空闲状态显示，让界面更加整洁。
Plugin title bars now feature a unified, lightweight ghost style for action buttons and hide redundant idle statuses to keep the interface clean.

new: 应用和插件通知现在会合并显示在底部提示条中，Chrome 菜单也会显示在编辑器工具栏上方。
improvements: 现在始终发送原生系统通知，并按插件分别限制通知频率。

new: App and plugin notices now appear together in a single bottom toast, and Chrome menus stay above editor toolbars.
improvements: Native system notifications are now always sent, with rate limits applied separately to each plugin.

fixes: 边栏批注卡片现在可以正常滚动浏览，全部发送批注改为在后台处理，且 AI 会解答提问而不是重写选中文本。
Margin annotation cards can now be scrolled through properly, sending all annotations is handled in the background, and AI answers questions instead of rewriting selected text.

improvements: 商店搜索框现已将来源与排序选项整合为框内的筛选按钮。
The Store search field now consolidates source and sorting options into an inline filter button.
查找和替换栏默认收起，点击切换按钮即可展开。
The find and replace row is collapsed by default and can be expanded with a toggle.

new: 使用查找快捷键可打开搜索并自动填入选中的文本，也可替换单个或全部匹配项。
fixes: 查找栏现在浮动显示在页面上方，不会挤压笔记内容。

new: The find shortcut opens search with the selected text and supports replacing one or all matches.
fixes: The find bar now floats over the page without pushing note content down.

new: 现在可以在设置中自定义搜索、查找、新建笔记和人工智能面板的应用内快捷键。
improvements: 人工智能与插件的错误消息现在同时提供中文和英文。
开关改为更轻巧的样式，轨道尺寸为 28×16，填充柔和的强调色，旋钮不带阴影，并在标题处显示状态文字。
界面统一了字号层级，设置标题为 20 像素，对话框标题为 15 像素，加粗标签更少，最小字号为 12 像素。
图标按钮新增预设样式，所有图标在悬停时都有动效，选中状态更柔和，并新增三个图标。
设置分类图标和应用商店图标已按统一的 24 像素网格重新绘制。
fixes: 设置侧边栏的图标现在与文字标签居中对齐，选中的图标也不再移位。
other: 移除了已停用的插件迁移特殊处理逻辑。

new: Settings now let you customize the in-app shortcuts for search, find, new note, and the AI panel.
improvements: AI and plugin error messages now appear in both English and Chinese.

Icon buttons now come with presets, every icon has a hover motion, selected states are softer, and three new icons have been added.

fixes: Settings sidebar icons now sit centered with their labels, and the selected icon no longer shifts.
other: Retired special cases for plugin migration have been removed.
